|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Don't Underestimate Our Chances (V)]] (version 2 of 4). This version has no document image of its own, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of this text ([[:File:VB6-94-Dont_Underestimate_Our_Chances-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]). Versions in date order: [[Don't Underestimate Our Chances (V)]] (original, release sheet of 4 September 2009); '''this page''' (PC-E1, PC website card list, by 21 July 2012); [[Don't Underestimate Our Chances (V) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2, Players Committee card image, uploaded 25 February 2013, the same words as the original); [[Don't Underestimate Our Chances (V) (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3, Master List of 27 April 2013, the same words as the original, the current text).
* '''Original''' ([[Don't Underestimate Our Chances (V)]]): text as given in the first copy of the Virtual Block 6.1 (Reflections IV) release sheet and the revised Virtual Block 6.1 release sheet (official text as of 4 September 2009): “USED: Initiate a battle for free. STARTING: If Dantooine Base Operations on table, ▼ Operations Center, Dantooine Engineering Corps, and up to two Effects which deploy on table (or your side of table), are always [Immune to Alter], and have no deploy cost. Place this Interrupt in Lost Pile.”.<ref name="sheet-6_1-first">Virtual Set 6: Reflections IV sheet, first copy ("Official text as of September 4, 2009"; attachment Block6WithRebelFleetV.pdf, [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1375528 Players Committee forum])</ref><ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock6_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf#page=12 Virtual Block 6.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of September 4, 2009"; revised copy, PDF dated 20 April 2010), page 12, slip 94. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195540/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf#page=12 Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again (Light Side, p. 33). Under the ruling of 11 November 2026 (every publication is a version), that copy is its own version, PC-E3 ([[Don't Underestimate Our Chances (V) (Errata 3)]]), and the current text.<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=33, page 33. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=33 Internet Archive]</ref> The release-sheet slip prints the slip number “94” at the bottom right.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 12 December 2012) changed “Dantooine Base Operations” to “Dantooine Operations” (the card list writes the ▼ and Immune to Alter icons out): “USED: Initiate a battle for free. STARTING: If Dantooine Operations on table, deploy from Reserve Deck Operations Center, Dantooine Engineering Corps, and up to two Effects which deploy on table (or your side of table), are always [Immune to Alter], and have no deploy cost. Place this Interrupt in Lost Pile.”.<ref name="cl-1261_94-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock6Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212001607/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-12-12] (Internet Archive)</ref> The card list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data (research R7, 11 November 2026), so this wording is a transcription the PC published, not a separately announced errata; it is listed because it was published.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Don't Underestimate Our Chances (V) (Errata 2)]]): the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB6-L-dontunderestimateourchances-pre.gif]]) prints the original release-sheet text ([[Don't Underestimate Our Chances (V)]]) again, word for word: “USED: Initiate a battle for free. STARTING: If Dantooine Base Operations on table, ▼ Operations Center, Dantooine Engineering Corps, and up to two Effects which deploy on table (or your side of table), are always [Immune to Alter], and have no deploy cost. Place this Interrupt in Lost Pile.” The image is dated only by its upload to the Players Committee's server: the Apache listing of the Virtual6-Light card-image folder gives every file there the same time, 25 February 2013, 11:34<ref name="pcdir-Virtual6-Light">Players Committee server, [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034714/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual6-Light/large/?C=M;O=A directory listing of cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual6-Light/large/] sorted by date, as captured 18 August 2019 (Internet Archive)</ref>. That is a bulk upload date, so the image may have been made earlier; it is placed at that date (ruling of 11 November 2026: what was uploaded last counts as the last version). It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). The PC card image prints the slip number “94” at the bottom right, as the release-sheet slip does.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Don't Underestimate Our Chances (V) (Errata 3)]]): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Light Side, p. 33)<ref name="ml-ls" /> prints the original release-sheet text ([[Don't Underestimate Our Chances (V)]]) again, word for word: “USED: Initiate a battle for free. STARTING: If Dantooine Base Operations on table, ▼ Operations Center, Dantooine Engineering Corps, and up to two Effects which deploy on table (or your side of table), are always [Immune to Alter], and have no deploy cost. Place this Interrupt in Lost Pile.” It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat of an earlier text), and, as the latest dated text, it is the current text. Its image is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1261-94-front-master.png]]). The Master List slip prints no slip number (the release-sheet slip and the PC card image print “94”).
